fields.title: Flow saves your place every few seconds while playing, so a crash reopens within a few words
fields.description: Flow saves progress during playback only when the page moves. Add a mode-local save on word advance at the same cadence as Focus (RSVP\_PROGRESS\_SAVE\_INTERVAL\_MS) plus pause and stop, with an explicit null cfi under CFI-POSITION-CONSISTENCY-1's contract.
fields.notes: origin: owner ruling O5, 2026-11-03 (Findings F-016): Flow and Narrate save as they go, like Focus under O4. Sequenced after CFI-POSITION-CONSISTENCY-1, reusing its cadence and null-cfi rule. Stub; spec to follow.
